st_technology: not applicable (tabular ACS PUMS survey microdata)
adaptation_note: A0 format adapted for tabular data as in results/round4/ppi/Q0_setup/acs_task_def.json: paths.adata/patches/embeddings and target_genes have no analogue and are replaced by paths.data and the outcome block; samples becomes clusters; the HEST donor folds are replaced by the five state folds of the predictor.

population.survey_weights: NOT used. PWGTP enters only through the filter PWGTP >= 1. Every sampled person passing the filter counts once.
population.design_based_target: the finite population of sampled persons that pass the filter (N = 1659616)

level_2.name: PUMA
level_2.nested_in: state (PUMA codes are unique only within a state)
level_2.setting: second setting: PUMAs within the single state with most persons after the filter

outcome.name: log PINCP
outcome.transform: natural log of PINCP; PINCP > 100 after the filter so the log is defined for every unit
outcome.zero_or_negative_handling: not needed: the filter removes PINCP <= 100 before the outcome exists

theta_3.name: AGEP, standardised
theta_3.standardisation: z = (AGEP - mean) / sd over all 1659616 filtered persons, sd with ddof=0

estimands.theta_2: mean of log PINCP (person-weighted and cluster-weighted as in plan section Q4)
estimands.theta_3: slope of log PINCP on standardised AGEP

predictor.cross_fit: five folds of states, fold = zlib.crc32(str(int(ST)).encode()) % 5

R2_description_only.definitions: unit: 1-SSE/SST over all filtered persons; within-state: 1-SSE/SST after subtracting each state mean of y and of yhat; state-level: squared Pearson correlation of the 51 state means of y and yhat (unweighted by persons). Description only, not a Q2 result.
